info.title: Deedbox.Cli
info.description: The deedbox command-line tool: schema scripts, status, key rewrap and lockfile diff.

options.name: --connection
options.description: The connection string. Defaults to the DEEDBOX_CONNECTION environment variable.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print or apply the Deedbox schema.

commands.name: script
commands.description: Print the SQL for every migration after --from.

options.name: --from
options.description: The schema version the database has now; 0 for a new database. [default: 0]

options.name: --native-json
options.description: SQL Server: convert the JSON columns to the native json type (SQL Server 2025, Azure SQL). [default: False]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply pending migrations under a database lock.

options.name: --native-json
options.description: SQL Server: convert the JSON columns to the native json type (SQL Server 2025, Azure SQL). [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show checkpoints, lag, stalled consumers with their poison event, and recent jobs.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the status as JSON. [default: False]

commands.name: rebuild
commands.description: Queue an in-place rebuild of a projection; the app's runner does it.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the job to finish; exit 1 if it fails. [default: False]

commands.name: skip
commands.description: Queue an audited skip of the event a consumer stalled on.

options.name: --event
options.description: The event it stalled on, from deedbox status.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the job to finish; exit 1 if it fails. [default: False]

commands.name: erase
commands.description: Delete a data subject's key now, and queue the job that finishes their erasure.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the job to finish; exit 1 if it fails. [default: False]

arguments.name: SUBJECT
arguments.description: The data subject, such as person:8421.

commands.name: rebuild
commands.description: Queue a rebuild of the stored state of every stream of a type.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the job to finish; exit 1 if it fails. [default: False]

commands.name: rewrap
commands.description: Re-wrap every tenant key with another master key. Events are not touched.

options.name: --from
options.description: The master key that wrapped the keys now: database, env:<VARIABLE> or azure:<key URL>.

options.name: --to
options.description: The master key to wrap them with: database, env:<VARIABLE> or azure:<key URL>.

commands.name: shred
commands.description: Crypto-shred a tenant: every personal field and sealed state of it reads as erased.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm: this destroys the tenant's keys and cannot be undone. [default: False]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show event-contract changes between two lockfiles; exit 1 when one breaks stored events.

arguments.name: OLD
arguments.description: The earlier lockfile, such as the one on the main branch.
